body:
I swallowed around 30 pills of 15mg dxm lst night.  I don't know if I had a mild allergic reaction of some sort or not, but for about 3 hours all I really experienced was uncontrollable itching.  I was feeling a buzz, but any pleasure was quickly overcome by the itching.  This was the first for me trying dxm, and I don't think I will again because of the itching.  I tried a dose of 150mg and I did notice a slight itch, but nothing compared to this last time.  After about 3 hours the itching died down and I could go to sleep, but the 3 hours it itched it seemed like an eternity.
